_readme: Webhook tools to add in ElevenLabs > Agent > Tools > Add webhook tool. Replace WORKER_URL and BUSINESS_ID. Add header Authorization: Bearer <TOOL_SECRET> (store TOOL_SECRET as a workspace secret). All bodies are JSON, method POST.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Get free appointment slots for one service on one date (UK time). Call this before offering any time to the caller. Returns up to 6 slots; offer the caller at most 3.

service_id.description: Service id from the business facts, for example 'mens-cut'.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD, UK local date. Convert words like 'tomorrow' or 'next Tuesday' yourself.

preferred_time.description: Optional preferred time HH:MM (24h). Slots closest to it are returned first.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Book a slot. Only call after the caller clearly confirmed service, date, time and name.

time.description: Start time HH:MM (24h) exactly as returned by check_availability.

customer_name.description: Caller's full name as they said it, in Latin or Persian letters.

customer_phone.description: Caller's mobile number, confirmed digit by digit. UK format 07... or +44...

language.description: 'fa' if the call is in Persian, 'en' if in English. Used for the SMS language.

notes.description: Short note, for example 'first visit' or 'prefers Ali'.

tools.name: find_bookings
tools.description: Find upcoming bookings for a phone number. Use when the caller wants to change or cancel.

customer_phone.description: Phone number the booking was made with.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Move an existing booking to a new free slot. Check availability first and confirm with the caller.

customer_phone.description: Same phone number used in find_bookings.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking after the caller confirmed which one.

customer_phone.description: Same phone number used in find_bookings.

tools.name: take_message
tools.description: Send a message to the business owner when you cannot help, a transfer is not possible, or the caller wants a call back.

message.description: The message in one or two sentences, in English, with key details (what, when).

system_tools.transfer_to_number: enable, number = phone_for_transfer from the business profile; condition: see Escalation in the system prompt
system_tools.skip_turn: enable (lets the caller think without the agent talking)
